title: Popular LLMs Amplify Race and Gender Disparities in Human Mobility

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to predict human mobility and Point of Interest (POI) visitation using prompts that vary implicit (name-based) and explicit racial identities, then measuring the statistical association between different racial groups and wealth-related versus poverty-related locations.

Prompting LLMs to predict human mobility and Point of Interest (POI) visitation using prompts that vary implicit (name-based) and explicit gender identities, then measuring the statistical association between genders and career-related versus everyday-needs locations.
